name: Crenshaw Melon
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as it's low in fermentable carbohydrates. Start with smaller portions if you have severe symptoms.
preparationTips: Choose melons that give slightly to pressure at the stem end
Store cut melon in refrigerator and consume within 3-4 days
Remove seeds and rind completely before eating
Can be frozen in chunks for smoothies
